About Us
ABOUT US
Built by and for field service professionals
Our mission
To automate everything but the wrench
Workiz aims to allow our service pros to focus on what they do best! By providing a business-in-a-box that automates every task, streamlines operations, enhances efficiency, and drives the business revenues.
Our story
The Workiz journey began with a couple of locksmith pros down in San Diego, California who surfed the waves by day and saved people who got locked out of their homes by night. The bigger their locksmith business grew, the more they realized how much time they were wasting on daily mundane tasks and that they needed a software system to help them out. In 2015, after extensive research they found nothing that perfectly suited the needs of their business and out of sheer frustration they decided to take matters into their own hands and create their very own field service digital headquarters.
Today, Workiz is one of the leading field service platforms with over 120,000 service pros who use and trust Workiz. We strive to help top field service professionals at the top of their game turn into business professionals who are increasing their revenue, and streamlining their operations. Our hope is that when we’re old and gray and ready to retire your business will be thriving and you will have the freedom to choose your next steps
Our values
At Workiz, we live on the growing edge and believe growth trumps everything else. Our growth mindset is reflected in every aspect of our operations, from our hiring decisions to our client growth, as well as product development and service culture. We pride ourselves in solving problems and creating solutions that make life easier, so we can all focus on what we love the most. The team at Workiz are creative thinkers and embody the perfect combination of empathy and drive. The success and growth of our customers are our top priorities, and we are constantly improving to ensure those goals are met.

Privacy policy
What's new
We posted updated versions of our Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy on November 2, 2026. The changes to our Terms take effect on November 12, 2026.
Texts and calls: You need your customers' consent before you text or call them through Workiz. We may ask you to confirm this in the app and keep a record of your confirmation. If messages are sent without consent, you're responsible for the claims that follow.
Phone usage: Some call types are billed at different per-minute rates. See how usage is calculated .
Payments: You authorize us and our payment processors (Stripe and Adyen) to debit your linked bank account for amounts you owe, such as negative balances, chargebacks and fees.
Card readers: Inspect your card readers once a month, and tell us within 24 hours if one is lost, stolen or tampered with.
Franchise networks: New rules for linking and unlinking locations, what data a franchisor can see, and who pays.
Text delivery: Our messaging provider may review message content to prevent spam and fraud.
AI features: How features like Genius Answering and Live Assist process data, and that we may use data to improve our AI models in the future. You can opt out anytime at info@workiz.com .
Workiz Inc. (“ Workiz ” “ us ”, “ we ”, or “ our ”) operates the www.workiz.com website (the “ Website ”), including Workiz’s application (“ App ”) (together, the “ Service(s) ”).
This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use and disclosure of Personal Information when you use our Service. Nothing in this Privacy Policy is intended to limit in any way your statutory right, including your rights to a remedy or means of enforcement.
We greatly respect your privacy, which is why we make every effort to provide a platform that would live up to the highest of user privacy standards. Please read this Privacy Policy carefully, so you can fully understand our practices and your rights in relation to Personal Information. Unless otherwise defined in this Privacy Policy, terms used in this Privacy Policy have the same meanings as in our Terms and Conditions, accessible at www.workiz.com .
1. Information collection and use
1.1. While using our Service, we will ask you to provide us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify you. Personally identifiable information may include, but is not limited to, the Pro and the Consumer’s email address, name, zip code, credit card details, phone number, postal address, other information (“ Personal Information ”).
1.2. In addition, if a Consumer uses WorkizPay to pay for goods and services, we will collect the Consumer’s name, email address, phone number, postal address, zip code and your credit card details used in the transaction with us.
1.3. If a Pro decides to make a Sunbit or Wisetack loan product available to a Consumer, we will collect the Consumer’s name, email address, postal address, zip code, credit card details and phone number.
1.4. If you participate in our referral program, we collect your name and email address. We collect this information for the purpose of providing the Service, including, without limitation, the Stripe payment services and the Sunbit facilitated loans, allowing you to participate in our referral program, and providing you with any rewards in accordance with our referral program terms, identifying and communicating with you, responding to your requests/inquiries, servicing your purchase orders, improving our services and marketing communication.
The consequences for not collecting this Personal Information are that we will not be able to provide you with the Services, or as applicable, advise technicians the location of the job, send notifications to Pros, allow you to participate in our referral program and/or process payments (amongst other things).
1.5. In addition to the Personal Information mentioned above, users of the Service(s) may provide Workiz with their cell phone number. If users provide their cell phone number, Workiz may use this information to provide support services. The cell phone numbers will be stored on our secure servers. Furthermore, with the user’s explicit consent, Workiz will also use the provided cell phone number to send SMSs and phone calls for marketing purposes.
Users have the option to opt out of receiving marketing communications at any time. To opt out, users can follow the instructions provided in the SMS or phone call, or they can contact Workiz Inc. directly by emailing info@workiz.com indicating their desire to opt out of receiving marketing communications. Please note that even if users opt out of receiving marketing communications, they may still receive non-marketing communications from Workiz related to the provision of Service(s) or support.
1.6. Franchise Networks. This Section 1.6 explains how information is shared when a Workiz customer that operates under a franchise agreement (a “ Franchisee ”) links its Workiz account to the Workiz account of its franchisor (the “ Franchisor ”). The contractual terms that apply between Workiz, Franchisees and Franchisors are set out in Section 2A (Franchise Networks) of our Terms and Conditions ( https://www.workiz.com/terms-and-conditions/ ).
1.6.1. When Sharing Happens. Workiz shares a Franchisee’s account information with its Franchisor only after the Franchisee authorizes the link to the Franchisor’s account and the Franchisor accepts it. Sharing continues until the link ends under Section 1.6.6.
1.6.2. What Is Shared. Depending on the permissions configured, the Franchisor may access: (A) business data, such as account settings, workflows, price books, templates and analytics; (B) job, estimate and invoice records, such as service requests, appointment schedules and job status; (C) dispatching and workforce information, such as technician names, assignments and status updates; (D) information about the Franchisee’s customers that is stored in the account, such as names, contact details, service addresses and job and service history; (E) payment and transaction records, such as amounts, dates and payment status; (F) call recordings, transcripts and messages, where the Franchisor’s permissions include them; and (G) reports and analytics, such as sales performance and service history.
1.6.3. Why Is It Shared. Workiz makes this information available so that the Franchisor can operate and manage its franchise system, for example to monitor location performance, calculate and verify royalties and other fees under the franchise agreement, maintain brand and service standards, dispatch jobs across territories, and support the Franchisee’s business. The Franchisor’s own use of the information is governed by the Franchisor’s privacy policy.
1.6.4. Franchisor Controls. A Franchisor may set permissions that limit the ability of users of a linked account to delete or change certain records. These permissions do not prevent the Franchisee from responding to a valid privacy request under applicable law (see Section 1.6.8).
1.6.5. Who Is Responsible. The Franchisee is responsible for the information about its customers that is stored in its account, and for giving its customers any notices and obtaining any consents that the law requires for sharing that information with its Franchisor. Workiz processes that information to provide the Service to the Franchisee and makes it available to the Franchisor as the Franchisee authorizes and as described in our Terms and Conditions. The Franchisor is responsible for its own use of the information it accesses, which is also governed by the Franchisor’s own privacy policy. Franchisors must use the information only for legitimate franchise business purposes, keep it confidential and secure, and comply with applicable privacy and data protection laws. When Workiz makes a Franchisee’s information available to its Franchisor, it does so on the Franchisee’s behalf and at the Franchisee’s direction, as part of the Service Workiz provides to the Franchisee.
1.6.6. Ending the Link. A Franchisee may ask to unlink its account at any time by contacting support@workiz.com . Workiz will notify the Franchisor and complete the request within ten (10) business days, unless the Franchisee has agreed in writing to a different procedure. If the Franchisor objects, completion may be delayed by up to ninety (90) days after Workiz receives the request, as described in our Terms and Conditions. A Franchisor may also end the link at any time. Unlinking stops further sharing. It does not affect information the Franchisor already accessed, which the Franchisor may keep and use only as permitted by its franchise agreement and applicable law. Unlinking may have consequences under the franchise agreement, which are a matter between the Franchisee and the Franchisor.
1.6.7. When a Franchise Relationship Ends or a Location Is Sold. Workiz will follow a joint instruction of the Franchisor and the Franchisee, a written designation agreed by the Franchisee as described in our Terms and Conditions, or a final order of a court or arbitrator. If none of these exists and they disagree, Workiz may restrict the account to view-only access and preserve its information for up to ninety (90) days, or longer if legal proceedings have begun, as described in Section 2A of our Terms and Conditions.
1.6.8. Customers of a Franchise Location. If you are a customer of a franchise location and want to exercise your privacy rights, such as a request to access or delete your information, please contact that location directly. If Workiz receives your request, we will forward it to the relevant Franchisee where appropriate and will assist the Franchisee in responding as required by applicable law. Questions about how a Franchisor uses your information should be sent to that Franchisor.
1.7. Please note that some of the Personal Information will be used for detecting, taking steps to prevent, and prosecution of fraud or other illegal activity, to identify and repair errors, to conduct audits, and for security purposes. Personal Information may also be used to comply with applicable laws, with investigations performed by the relevant authorities, law enforcement purposes, and/or to exercise or defend legal claims. In certain cases, we may or will anonymize or de-identify your Personal Information and further use it for internal and external purposes, including, without limitation, to improve the services and for research purposes.
1.8. “ Anonymous Information ” means information which does not enable identification of an individual user, such as aggregated information about the use of our services. We may use Anonymous Information and/or disclose it to third parties without restrictions (for example, in order to improve our services and enhance your experience with them).
1.9. Use of Generative AI Tools and Automated Chat Services
Workiz leverages advanced generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, including an automated chat service powered by Ultimate.ai and OpenAI, Assembly AI . These AI technologies are employed in various capacities, such as enabling our customers to generate custom text for communications, assisting users through AI-driven chatbots on our website, and offering call recording and transcription services facilitated by AI to streamline interactions between Workiz customers and their clients. Workiz also offers additional AI-powered features, including AI-powered answering and receptionist features (such as "Jessica" or "Genius Answering") that may autonomously initiate and manage actions and communications with end users, AI-driven marketing and lead capture features, and real-time call transcription and job creation features ("Live Assist"). These features may collect and process personal data through automated interactions without continuous human oversight.
Our website features an automated chat service designed to offer quick and efficient answers to your inquiries. It’s important to note that interactions through this service are conducted with an AI-powered chatbot, not a human representative. This service is provided to facilitate immediate support, guidance, and information retrieval for our users, enhancing their experience on our platform.
In delivering these AI-powered services, Workiz and our trusted AI technology partners, including Ultimate.ai, OpenAI and Assembly AI, may collect and process personal data provided during interactions with the AI tools. This may include names, contact details, and conversation logs, recordings and transcripts. The collection and processing of this information aims to provide, improve, and personalize our Services. Workiz may also use such data to train, fine-tune, and improve its AI models. If you do not wish your data to be used by Workiz for training purposes, please contact us at info@workiz.com . Please also note that certain AI providers may use interaction data to improve their AI models; please refer to the privacy policies of the relevant AI providers for further information on whether and how your data may be used for training purposes. This information will be stored on their servers.
You can learn more about AssemblyAI and read its privacy policy at https://www.assemblyai.com/legal/privacy-policy .
You can learn more about OpenAI and read its privacy policy at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/legal/cognitive-services/openai/data-privacy .
You can learn more about Ultimate.ai and read its privacy policy at https://www.ultimate.ai/security-privacy .
By using Workiz AI tools and by interacting with Workiz AI-powered chatbot, you acknowledge and consent to the collection, storage and processing of your voice recordings and transcripts by Workiz. The collection and processing of this information is for providing and improving our Services, and to provide support.
2. Log and device data
We will also collect information that your browser sends whenever you visit our Service (“ Log Data ”). This Log Data may include information such as your computer’s Internet Protocol (“ IP ”) address, browser type, browser version, the pages of our Service that you visit, the time and date of your visit, the time spent on those pages and other statistics.
We may also collect information pertaining to your device, including, but not limited to, device configurations and usage patterns (“ Device Data ”). Device Data may encompass details such as the device's operating system and version, enabled device settings (for example, Push Notifications), the version of the application installed, and any other relevant technical or usage-related data. Workiz may share User Device Data with authorized account administrators (including, for an account linked to a Franchisor under Section 1.6, the Franchisor’s authorized users) for operational, administrative, or account management purposes.
3. Analytic tools
We may use third party services that collect, monitor and analyze this type of information in order to increase our Service’s functionality. These third party service providers have their own privacy policies addressing how they use such information. We reserve the right to remove or add new analytic tools.
Google Analytics
Google Analytics collects information such as how often users visit this Website, what pages they visit when they do so, and what other websites they used prior to coming to this Website. We use the information we get from Google Analytics to maintain and improve the Website and our products. We do not combine the information collected through the use of Google Analytics with Personal Information we collect. Google’s ability to use and share information collected by Google Analytics about your visits to this Website is restricted by the Google Analytics Terms of Service, available at https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/terms/us/ , and the Google Privacy Policy, available at policies.google.com/privacy .
You may learn more about how Google collects and processes data specifically in connection with Google Analytics at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites .
You may prevent your data from being used by Google Analytics by downloading and installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on, available at tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout/ .
Hotjar
We use Hotjar in order to better understand our users’ needs and to optimize this service and experience. Hotjar is a technology service that helps us better understand our users’ experience (e.g. how much time they spend on which pages, which links they choose to click, what users do and don’t like, etc.) and this enables us to build and maintain our service with user feedback.
Hotjar uses cookies and other technologies to collect data on our users’ behavior and their devices. This includes a device’s IP address (processed during your session and stored in a de-identified form), device screen size, device type (unique device identifiers), browser information, geographic location (country only), and the preferred language used to display our website.
Hotjar stores this information on our behalf in a pseudonymized user profile. Hotjar is contractually forbidden to sell any of the data collected on our behalf. For further details, please see the ‘about Hotjar’ section of Hotjar’s support site.
Cookies
Cookies are files with a small amount of data, which may include an anonymous unique identifier. Cookies are sent to your browser from a web site and transferred to your device. We use cookies to collect information in order to improve our Services for you.
You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. The Help feature on most browsers provides information on how to accept cookies, disable cookies or to notify you when receiving a new cookie.
If you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some features of our Service and we recommend that you leave them turned on.
4. Location data.
Once you download the mobile App, the mobile App will request access to your device location. When access is granted, Workiz will be able to track the physical location of your device. This information will be used to provide the Service and to improve our mobile App.
You can remove the App location tracking or change the location tracking permission to a specific time by changing your privacy settings on your device.
5. Marketing practices
Through our Services, we allow third party advertising to set technologies and other tracking tools to collect information regarding your activities and your device (e.g., your IP address, mobile/App/Website identifiers, page(s) visited, location, time of day). We also combine and share such information and other information (such as demographic information and past purchase history) with third party advertising partners. These advertising partners will use this information (and similar information collected from other websites) for purposes of delivering targeted and/or behavioral advertisements to you when you visit third party websites within their networks. This practice is commonly referred to as “interest-based advertising” or “online behavioral advertising. We allow access to other data collected by the services to share information that may be useful, relevant, valuable or otherwise of interest to you. If you prefer not to share your Personal Information with third party advertising partners, you may let us know.
Google
Google AdWords remarketing service is provided by Google Inc. You can opt-out of Google Analytics for Display Advertising and customize the Google Display Network ads by visiting the Google Ads Settings page: www.google.com/ads/preferences/html/blocked-cookies.html
Google also recommends installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on – tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout – for your web browser. Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on provides visitors with the ability to prevent their data from being collected and used by Google Analytics.
For more information on the privacy practices of Google, please visit the Google Privacy & Terms web page: www.google.com/intl/en/policies/privacy/
Facebook
Facebook remarketing service is provided by Facebook Inc. You can learn more about interest-based advertising from Facebook by visiting this page: www.facebook.com/help/164968693837950

You can also opt-out from Facebook and other participating companies through the Digital Advertising Alliance in the USA optout.aboutads.info/?c=2&lang=EN , the Digital Advertising Alliance of Canada in Canada youradchoices.ca/ or the European Interactive Digital Advertising Alliance in Europe youronlinechoices.eu/ , or opt-out using your mobile device settings.
For more information on the privacy practices of Facebook, please visit Facebook’s Data Policy: www.facebook.com/privacy/explanation
6. Service providers
We may share your Personal Information with our business partners with whom we jointly offer products or services, and depending on the type of Personal Information, with our customers, consultants and payment processors, including without limitation Stripe Sunbit and Adyen. You can learn more about Stripe, Sunbit and Adyen and read their respective privacy policies at https://stripe.com/privacy , www.sunbit.com/consumer_privacy/ and https://www.adyen.com/privacy-policy . We may employ third party companies and individuals to facilitate our Service, to provide the Service on our behalf, to perform Service-related services and/or to assist us in analyzing how our Service is used. We will also provide your Personal Information to our third party debt collection service providers in order to recover any debts owning to Workiz from Pros. These third parties have access to your Personal Information only to perform specific tasks on our behalf and are obligated not to disclose or use your Personal Information for any other purpose.
Plaid – Workiz uses Plaid Inc. (“Plaid”) to gather your data from financial institutions in order to connect your Workiz account with your bank account, verify your bank account and confirm your bank account balance prior to approving a transaction. By using our service, you grant Workiz and Plaid the right, power, and authority to act on your behalf to access and transmit your personal and financial information from your relevant financial institution. You agree to your personal and financial information being transferred, stored, and processed by Plaid in accordance with the Plaid privacy policy.
Sharing with Third-Party AI Providers: Workiz may share the personal data collected by AI tools with third-party AI technology providers such as Ultimate.ai, OpenAI and AssemblyAI as necessary to enable the functionalities of these tools. By engaging with our AI-powered services, including the automated chat service, you consent to the collection, use, and sharing of personal data as outlined in this policy and the respective third-party AI providers privacy policy.
Third Party Integrations: When you choose to connect your Workiz account with a third-party service through our platform (for example, when you integrate with Yelp), you acknowledge and agree that third parties may collect, use, and process your information independently in accordance with their own terms and privacy policies. Workiz may enable or facilitate these integrations, but does not control, endorse or assume responsibility for the actions, omissions or practices of any third party’s services. If you connect third-party accounts, we may receive and display information made available by those third parties through the integration (which may include personal information, content and metadata) and may transmit information back to those third parties on your behalf as part of the integration’s functionality. If you have any issues, questions, or concerns regarding a third-party service, you should contact the third party directly. Workiz disclaims any responsibility or liability for the practices, actions, or omissions of any third-party service or for how such third parties handle your information. Your interactions with third-party services are solely between you and the applicable third party.
7. Communications
We may use your Personal Information to contact you with newsletters, marketing or promotional materials and other information that may be of interest to you. You may opt out of receiving any, or all, of these communications from us by following the unsubscribe link or instructions provided in any email we send.
8. SMS notifications and terms
8.1. Workiz may provide SMS notifications to users who opt-in to this service (the " Messaging Service "). Workiz may disclose Personal Data and other information as follows:
Third Parties that Help Provide the Messaging Service: We will not share your opt-in to an SMS short code campaign with a third party for purposes unrelated to supporting you in connection with that campaign. We may share your Personal Data with third parties that help us provide the messaging service, including, but not limited to, platform providers, phone companies, and other vendors who assist us in delivering text messages.
Additional Disclosures:
Affiliates: We may disclose Personal Data to our affiliates or subsidiaries; however, their use and disclosure of your Personal Data will be subject to this Policy. All the above categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties. Workiz does not share mobile data collected through the Messaging Service (including phone numbers, app usage data, and location data) with third parties for marketing or promotional purposes.
Messaging Infrastructure Providers: Please note that Workiz uses third-party messaging infrastructure providers (such as Twilio) to deliver text messages. Such providers may collect and monitor the content of text messages sent to U.S. and Canadian numbers for purposes of spam detection, fraud prevention, and policy enforcement, subject to their own privacy policies. Please refer to the privacy policy of the relevant messaging infrastructure provider for further information.
8.2. Purpose of SMS Notifications: Our SMS notifications are designed to:
Remind you of your scheduled visits.
Inform you of upcoming services, payment reminders, and other essential notifications related to Workiz.
To provide support services.
8.3. Opt-In and Consent: By providing your phone number and opting into our SMS notifications, you confirm that you are the owner or authorized user of the phone number provided. You consent to receive recurring automated text messages (SMS, MMS) from us regarding your scheduled visits, service updates, offers, to receive support, and other important notifications. Consent is not required to make any purchase from us. Message frequency may vary, but you can generally expect to receive between 1-5 messages per week.
8.4. Opt-Out Instructions: Your consent to receive automated texts is entirely voluntary. You may opt-out at any time: ○ To stop receiving messages, reply “STOP,” “END,” “CANCEL,” “UNSUBSCRIBE,” or “QUIT” to any SMS message from us.
You may also email us at unsubscribe@Workiz.com with your opt-out request. After you opt out, you will receive a final confirmation message, and no further messages will be sent to your number unless you re-enroll.
8.5. Help and Support: If you are experiencing issues with our SMS notifications or need assistance, you can:
Reply with the keyword “HELP” to any message.
Email us directly at support@Workiz.com .
8.6. Message and Data Rates: Message and data rates may apply for any messages sent to you from us and from you to us. Please consult your mobile service provider for details regarding your text plan or data rates.
8.7. Carrier Liability: Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.
9. Your privacy rights. How to delete your account
Rights : You can exercise your rights by contacting us at info@workiz.com . Subject to legal and other permissible considerations, we will make every reasonable effort to honor your request promptly in accordance with applicable law or inform you if we require further information in order to fulfill your request. When processing your request, we may ask you for additional information to confirm or verify your identity and for security purposes, before processing and/or honoring your request. We reserve the right to charge a fee where permitted by law, for instance if your request is manifestly unfounded or excessive. In the event that your request would adversely affect the rights and freedoms of others (for example, would impact the duty of confidentiality we owe to others) or if we are legally entitled to deal with your request in a different way than initial requested, we will address your request to the maximum extent possible, all in accordance with applicable law.
Deleting your account : Should you ever decide to delete your account, you may do so by emailing info@workiz.com . If you terminate your account, any association between your account and Personal Information we store will no longer be accessible through your account. However, given the nature of sharing on certain services, any public activity on your account prior to deletion will remain stored on our servers and will remain accessible to the public.
10. Compliance with laws
We will disclose your Personal Information where required to do so by law, subpoena or court order, or if we believe that such action is necessary to comply with applicable law and the reasonable requests of law enforcement. We may also disclose your Personal Information if we become aware of suspected criminal activity or other conduct that may constitute a crime, and we determine in good faith that disclosure is necessary to report such activity to the appropriate authorities, to protect the security or integrity of our Service, or to protect our rights, property, or safety (or those of our users or others).
Pro-to-Consumer Text Messages. Workiz’s Service allows Pros (our business customers) to send text messages to their own customers (“Consumers”) using Workiz’s platform in connection with third-party messaging infrastructure providers. With respect to the content of these messages and any related consent records, Workiz acts solely as a technology platform provider acting on Pro’s instructions, not as the sender or as a voice or messaging service provider. Pro is responsible for obtaining consent from its Consumers and for complying with applicable messaging laws, including, without limitation, the TCPA and mobile carrier requirements. Where Pro’s use of the Service includes a consent-acknowledgment step, Workiz may retain a record of that acknowledgment, including the date, time, user ID, account ID, and the exact text presented to Pro, for compliance and audit purposes.
11. Business transaction
If, in the future, Workiz sell or transfers, or we consider selling or transferring, some or all of our business, shares or assets to a third party, we will disclose your Personal Information to such third party (whether actual or potential) in connection with the foregoing events. In the event that we are acquired by, or merged with, a third party entity, or in the event of bankruptcy or a comparable event, we reserve the right to transfer, disclose or assign your Personal Information in connection with the foregoing events, including, in connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of company assets, consolidation or restructuring, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business by or to another company.
12. Security and retention of your Personal Information
The security of your Personal Information is important to us, and we strive to implement and maintain reasonable and commercially acceptable security procedures and practices appropriate to the nature of the information we store, in order to protect it from unauthorized access, destruction, use, modification, or disclosure. However, please be aware that no method of transmission over the internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure and we are unable to guarantee the absolute security of the Personal Information we have collected from you.
Your Personal Information will be stored until we delete the record and we proactively delete it or you send a valid deletion request, please note that in some circumstances we may store your Personal Information for longer periods of time, for example: (i) where we are required to do so in accordance with legal, regulatory, tax or accounting requirements, or (ii) for us to have an accurate record of your dealings with us in the event of any complaints or challenges, or (iii) if we reasonably believe there is a prospect of litigation relating to your Personal Information or dealings.
13. International transfer
Your information, including Personal Information, may be transferred to — and maintained on – servers located outside of your state, province, country or other governmental jurisdiction where the data protection laws may differ than those from your jurisdiction.
If you are located outside United States and choose to provide information to us, please note that we transfer the information, including Personal Information, to United States and process it there.
To the maximum extent permitted by law, your consent to this Privacy Policy followed by your submission of such information represents your agreement to that transfer.
14. Links to other sites
Our Service may contain links to other sites that are not operated by us. If you click on a third party link, you will be directed to that third party’s site. We strongly advise you to review the Privacy Policy of every site you visit. We have no control over, and assume no responsibility for the content, privacy policies or practices of any third party sites or services.
15. Children’s privacy
Only persons age 18 or older have permission to access our Service. Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 18 (“ Children ”). We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 18. If you are a parent or guardian and you learn that your Children have provided us with Personal Information, please contact us. If we become aware that we have collected Personal Information from a children under age 18 without verification of parental consent, we take steps to remove that information from our servers.
16. Changes to this Privacy Policy
This version of this Privacy Policy is effective as of the “Last Updated” date shown below and will remain in effect except with respect to any changes in its provisions in the future, which will be in effect immediately after being posted on this page.
We reserve the right to update or change our Privacy Policy at any time and you should check this Privacy Policy periodically. Your continued use of the Service after we post any modifications to the Privacy Policy on this page will constitute your acknowledgment of the modifications. If we make any material changes to this Privacy Policy, we will notify you either through the email address you have provided us, by placing a prominent notice on our website or by other means.
17. Contact us
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact our support team by writing to Workiz Inc. 9444 Balboa Ave, San Diego, CA 92123.
Or email us at: info@workiz.com

Frequently asked questions
How does the free trial work?
Workiz offers a 7 days free trial that allows you to explore all the features of the platform without any commitment. You can sign up directly on the Workiz website and start using the platform immediately. No credit card is required for the trial period: Start here: Free Trial .
How does the annual discount work?
Workiz offers discounted rates for annual subscriptions compared to monthly billing. By choosing an annual plan, you can save $400+, providing better value for long-term use. Specific discount details are available on the Pricing Page.
What size businesses is Workiz built for?
Workiz is built for field service businesses of every size:
Growing teams run their whole business from one app.
Mid size teams that needs support across multiple locations.
Larger teams use it to manage dispatching, inventory, reporting, and multiple crew locations as they scale.
Does Workiz integrate with QuickBooks?
Absolutely. Workiz seamlessly integrates with QuickBooks Online, allowing for automatic synchronization of invoices, customers, and payments. More information can be found on the QuickBooks Integration Page .
What is Workiz's integrated phone system?
Workiz offers for all the plans a built-in phone system that enables you to manage all customer communications directly within the platform. Features include call tracking, recording, masking, and automated messaging, enhancing both team collaboration and customer service. Details are available on the Features Page .
What are the benefits of using Workiz’s integrated phone system? Utilizing Workiz’s integrated phone system provides several advantages:
Centralized Communication : Manage all calls and messages in one place, reducing the need for external tools.
Enhanced Professionalism : Features like call masking and recording ensure secure and professional interactions.
Improved Efficiency : Automated messaging and call tracking streamline workflows and save time.
These features contribute to better customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. Explore: Features Page
